xinhua-cj10a-caution.title: Xinhua: CJ-10A in the Rocket Force parade context
xinhua-cj10a-caution.note: Identity caution: this original report describes the land-based Rocket Force context, not an H-6K air-launched installation. It does not establish equivalence with KD-20, CJ-20 or CJ-20A. Existing runtime identity remains unverified.

hangar-vlm.title: Shared Hangar aircraft VLM tables
hangar-vlm.note: Same base, rate and Mach data as the released JSBSim model; no equipment calibration claim.

method_sources: Katz and Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, vortex lattice
Shared aero/model.py, tables.py and mach.py; engineering extensions are not equipment measurements

limitations: Generic AGARD-B geometry, not any of the 88 authored equipment models.
The publication pools facilities/model sizes and includes M0.8/M1.2 runs with the M0.77/M1.17 groups; no common Reynolds condition is supplied.
Body-normal force is derived as CN=CLf*cos(alpha)+CDf*sin(alpha), cancelling axial base-pressure force; reported CZ=-CN.
The 4% biconvex wing uses the existing shared section; its tiny specified leading-edge radius is not separately resolved.
Density/Reynolds and sting/wall interference differences remain. Residuals are not an equipment confidence interval.
No beta, dynamic derivative, powered flow or extreme-angle qualification follows from these conditions.

uncertainty.method: Coupled vortex-lattice/body/section/rate solution, common Mach extensions and common JSBSim tables; retained overrides are listed separately.
uncertainty.table_domain: Actual Mach/alpha/beta bounds are read from the generated product in hangar-vlm.simulation; no narrowing of the authored envelope.
uncertainty.uncertainty_basis: assumed engineering screening range, not measured equipment error or a probabilistic confidence interval
uncertainty.uncertainty_formula: Inside the generic comparison conditions: max(1,2*generic_NRMSE/100); outside them no finite equipment-error bound is established.
uncertainty.boundaries: Generic validation cannot identify equipment-specific separated flow, powered flow, Reynolds effects or extreme-angle errors; those remain unknown.
uncertainty.uncertainty_application: Assumed screening envelope only, not a measured model error or statistical bound. Applies to generic CZ/Cm comparison conditions; no finite equipment-error bound outside those conditions and no calibrated CD/CY/Cl/Cn uncertainty.
uncertainty.input_assumptions: Author-declared geometry and shared section/body correlations. Surface sections, sweep, twist, controls, body stations, mass/CG, analysis speed and all retained overrides are readable in aircraft/cj10a/cj10a.toml. Product extrema are generation coverage, not a validated physical domain.

mass_kg.note: the family's heaviest (the page: 'the HN-3 at 0.75 m and 1,800 kg'; its table's HN-1, 'Launch Weight: 1,200 kg'); DH-10 and CJ-10 are its alternate names there, no figure given for the CJ-10A by name

length_m.note: the page's table: 'Length: 6.4 m (7.2 m inc. boost motor)' - air-launched, without the boost motor

drag_area_m2.note: Engineering estimate A_D = CD_simulated*S_geometry at neutral Mach .3. Inputs, dated model-specific searches and method limits are in hangar-vlm.simulation and the evidence catalog. Assumed one-sigma screening uncertainty is |A_D| in m2; its coverage probability is not established. Equipment drag error remains unknown; the table evidence basis is simulated.
